blocks.text: Sentences and their English: Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR). Words, meanings and how each word is built: the English Wiktionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.why: **счастли́вец** — lucky dog, lucky man. Wiktionary: счастли́вый + -ец.
**па́мятник** — monument, memorial, tombstone, statue. Wiktionary: па́мять + -ник.

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: образец — specimen; счастли́вец — lucky dog, lucky man; купец — (historical) merchant, trader; па́мятник — monument, memorial, tombstone, statue.
**лётчик** — (aviation) airman, pilot, flyer, aviator. Wiktionary: лете́ть + -чик.
**резец** — cutter, cutting tool, chisel, draw knife. Wiktionary: резать + -ец.

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: помо́щник — associate, assistant, deputy; уча́стник — participant, participator; лётчик — (aviation) airman, pilot, flyer, aviator; печник — stovemaker, oven-maker.
